tenderAddress.blockNumber: Chief Engineer (Electrical Designs), Karnataka Power Corporation Ltd., No-3, (Green Building), 3rd Floor, Behind Drug Controller Office Premises, Palace Road, Bengaluru- 560 001.

generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have successfully carried out periodic tests of generators prescribed under Regulation 40 of IEGC 2023 for thermal generating units of 200 MW & above or hydro generating units of 25 MW & above during the last FIVE (05) years (as on date of issue of NIT). In proof of the above, the scanned copies of at least one work order/work orders with contract value not less than Rs.30.00 Lakh (excluding GST) and corresponding satisfactory work completion certificate issued from the competent authority shall be furnished. (A weightage of 10% per year is applicable to previous work/purchase orders to bring the current price level of 2026-27).

The Bidder shall be a registered Service Provider / Contractor / Agency. In proof, the scanned copy of the Certificate of Incorporation / Establishment Registration Certificate / MSME Udyam Registration Certificate shall be furnished.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Certificate of Incorporation / Establishment Registration Certificate / MSME Udyam Registration Certificate

technicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should have achieved an average annual financial turnover of Rs.60.00 Lakh at least in two financial years of the preceding five financial years (as on date of issue of NIT). In proof of the above, the scanned copies of Annual Report / Turn-over Certificates / Profit & loss statement duly certified by chartered accountant and with valid UDIN shall be furnished. (A weightage of 10% per year is applicable to previous annual turnover to bring the current price level of 2026-27).

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall possess qualified field engineers and necessary testing instruments, software tools and data acquisition systems required for carrying out the prescribed tests under Regulation 40 of IEGC-2023. An undertaking in this regard along with details of key personnel and testing facilities shall be furnished

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Undertaking in this regard along with details of key personnel and testing facilities.

technicalCriterionList.description: Undertaking by intending bidder in the form of a notarized affidavit as per schedule declaring that during the past 3 (three) years: Their EMD has not forfeited, None of their contracts have been terminated/foreclosed on account of their default in KPCL or others, They have not been blacklisted/subject to procedure initiated for blacklisting for participation in tender issued by KPCL or Government or any other utility in India and would not attract terms and conditions relating to rejection of bids.
